seoTitle: ICS Calendar Event File Creator with Reminder
metaDescription: Make a downloadable .ics event with title, time, place, notes and reminder for Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar.
intro: Builds a standards-style iCalendar (.ics) file for one event, with an optional reminder and all-day option, and lets you download it.
why:
An .ics file opens in any calendar app. Fill the form and get a file to send or attach.

Times are converted from your chosen time zone to UTC, so there is no timezone block to break. Text is escaped and lines are folded as the spec requires. The output was parsed with the Python icalendar library.
howTo: Set the time zone, location and reminder.

faq.a: The IANA zone you type, then converted to UTC.
No, one event. Use the recurring date generator for a list.
It is built in your browser and never uploaded.
